about: Made by .github/desktop/ai/make_relief_video_golden.py, whose header describes each step. The image of the relief cases is the pattern of relief_golden_v1.json (32 x 8); sbs and halfSbs are rows of R, G, B bytes of the whole frame; holes are rows of the right eye where 1 marks a filled pixel. The vdaInput and lumaHistogram cases name their source picture by width, height and seed (pattern() of the script) and give float32 values, channels first.

relief.name: normal
